use_context: GitHub-hosted Ubuntu 24.04 x64 repository verification; no Owner data, secrets, write token, publication or persistent cache
conditions: Local materialization only; a separate Owner authority is required before any push or remote activation.
Use the exact three upstream commit pins and the explicit uv archive checksum; reassess changed releases, bytes, privileges or use context.
Only contents:read; no credential persistence, custom secrets, OIDC, artifact upload or cache restore/save.
Hosted runners have ambient Internet egress and passwordless sudo. This workflow is not an OS sandbox or network allowlist.
The first real run must verify Linux wheels, interpreter/ABI, action execution and actual editable-build backend versions before operational acceptance.
Retain upstream licenses if distributing action/tool copies; none are vendored or redistributed by this increment.
Inspect material upstream security, ownership and runtime changes on update; no exhaustive bundled-JavaScript or CVE audit is claimed.

uv.conditions: Checksum binds the downloaded archive, not an independently reproduced binary. setup-uv tool-cache hits bypass download verification; inspect the first fresh hosted run. Darwin binary admission remains separate.

actions/checkout.provenance: Official release and refs/tags/v7.0.1 resolve to this commit in actions/checkout, not a fork.
actions/checkout.effects: Runs bundled JavaScript/toolkit and Git; downloads one commit into workspace. Uses job contents-read token for checkout, does not persist it with persist-credentials:false. No LFS/submodules, cache or push.
actions/checkout.maintenance_exit: GitHub-maintained release; reassess major/runtime/security changes. Replace checkout boundary independently; no product API dependency.

actions/setup-python.provenance: Official release and refs/tags/v7.0.0 resolve to this commit in actions/setup-python, not a fork.
actions/setup-python.effects: Runs bundled JavaScript/toolkit; reads hosted tool cache or downloads actions/python-versions CPython, executes distribution setup and adjusts PATH. Default job token is available for release API reads. No dependency cache input, no custom token or secrets.
actions/setup-python.maintenance_exit: GitHub-maintained release. Python distribution is separate from the action and local Homebrew; verify exact patch, ordinary GIL, x64 and ABI. Replace setup boundary independently.

astral-sh/setup-uv.provenance: Official release and refs/tags/v10.0.1 resolve to this commit in astral-sh/setup-uv, not a fork.
astral-sh/setup-uv.effects: Runs bundled JavaScript/toolkit; downloads and verifies the explicit uv archive SHA256 before extraction, adjusts PATH/tool cache. Job token may be accessed by actions; no explicit custom token. Cross-run dependency/Python cache, mirror and environment activation disabled. No Python installation or self-update requested.
astral-sh/setup-uv.maintenance_exit: Astral-maintained release. Action identity and installed uv identity are separate. The embedded checksum table lacks uv0.12.7, so explicit checksum is mandatory. Replace setup with another separately admitted downloader if needed.
